findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_trifit_account, fetch, get_partner_access_requirements, get_partner_application_guide · Private data: prepare_trifit_upload, show_trifit_try_on, get_guest_demo_status, prepare_guest_upload, create_try_on, fetch · Public sink: get_trifit_account, prepare_trifit_upload, upload_trifit_image, create_trifit_try_on, show_trifit_try_on, get_guest_demo_status, prepare_guest_upload, search, get_partner_access_requirements, get_partner_application_guide · Destructive: get_trifit_allowance, create_trifit_try_on.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
